Overview
- Drink Hot or Cold! - 100% Natural Product - Relieves Occasional Constipation - Kosher - Herbal Supplement
Assorted Tea Collection:  - Blackberry Flavor - Cranberry Flavor - Wild Berry Flavor - Acai Berry Flavor - Goji Berry Flavor

How it works:  A unique blend of herbs which consist of senna, licorice, cinnamon, fennel, ginger, coriander, bael, and natural flavors help ease minor digestive discomfort.*  Supports healthy digestion and works as a gentle laxative for occasional irregularity.*  Supports weight loss by maintaining normal metabolism of fat and carbohydrates.*  *To attain maximum benefit, it is important to maintain a healthy, balanced diet which is high in fiber, drink plenty of water, and exercise regularly.

Suggested use
Drink 1 cup preferably after your last meal of the day. Do not exceed 2 cups in a 24-hour period.  Hot Tea - Pour 8 fl. oz. of freshly boiled water in a cup over your tea bag. Cover and steep for 5-8 minutes. Gently squeeze the tea bag to release any remaining extract.  Iced Tea - Prepare hot tea with 4 fl. oz. of water. Let it cool and pour into an ice-filled glass. The melting ice will dilute tea to serving strength.  These steps directly influence the amount of beneficial components that end up in your cup.

Other ingredients
Natural flavors.

Warnings
This product contains senna leaf. Read and follow directions carefully. Do not use if you have or develop diarrhea, loose stools, vomiting or abdominal pain because senna leaf may worsen these conditions. Consult your physician if you have frequent diarrhea or if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition, prior to use of this product. Do not exceed the recommended dose.  Keep out of reach of children.  Store in a dry place with no odors.

Overview
- Est. 1967 - Iron Supplement - Supports Red Blood Cell Formation - Mason Guarantee - Laboratory Tested - cGMP - Certified Good Manufacturing Practice - Dietary Supplement - Gluten Free - Soy Free  Ferrous gluconate is a very popular form of iron supplement because it may be gentler on the stomach and more absorbable than traditional iron supplements. The benefits of iron often go unnoticed until a person is not getting enough in their diet. Iron deficiency anemia can cause fatigue, heart palpitations, pale skin, and breathlessness. Iron supplements like ferrous gluconate may help with red blood cell formation for people who are not getting adequate iron in their diet. Having the recommended daily intake of iron may support healthy hemoglobin levels needed to transport oxygen in the blood, as well as, support for hair and nail growth. Our ferrous gluconate tablets provide 150% of your daily requirement of iron and may be easier on your stomach than other traditional forms of iron. Mason Natural offers iron supplements in a variety of high-quality formulations to suit your needs.

Suggested use
Adults - Take one tablet daily with a full glass of water, preferably with food, as a dietary supplement.

Other ingredients
Microcrystalline cellulose, croscarmellose sodium, vegetable stearic acid, polyvinyl alcohol, titanium dioxide, polyethylene glycol, magnesium silicate, fd&c blue #1, fd&c yellow #5, fd&c red #40.  Contains fd&c yellow #5 (tartrazine) as a color additive.  Guaranteed no added: dairy, egg, fish, crustacean shellfish, peanuts, tree nuts, wheat, soy, yeast, sesame.

Warnings
The treatment of any anemic condition should be under the advice and supervision of a physician. Do not exceed recommended dosage. If you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medications or have any medical condition, consult your physician before use. Discontinue use and consult your physician if any adverse reactions occur.  Accidental overdose of iron-containing products is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under 6. Keep this product out of reach of children. In case of accidental overdose, call a doctor or poison control center immediately.  Tamper-Evident Seal: Do not use product if seal appears tampered with.  Store in a dry place under controlled room temperature: 20°-25°C (68°-77°F).

Overview
- Original Root Stimulator™ - Same Great Formula  Rich moisturizing crème hydrates weak and damaged hair. Enriched with nutrient-rich Nettle Leaf and Horsetail to help nourish hair and scalp.  ORS™ Original Root Stimulator™* Hair Fertilizer™ helps to nourish weak and damaged hair.  *The plant root in this product plus the listed ingredients are historically known to help stimulate the scalp and nourish hair.

Suggested use
Use daily, or as often as needed. Apply a small amount directly to the scalp and massage gently. Comb through for even distribution from roots to ends.

Other ingredients
Water, glycine soja (soybean) oil, c12-15 alkyl benzoate, cetearyl alcohol, petrolatum, isopropyl myristate, ricinus communis (castor) seed oil, sodium cetearyl sulfate, urtica dioica (nettle) leaf powder, capsicum frutescens fruit extract, equisetum arvense extract, cola nitida seed extract, panthenol, cholesterol, zea mays (corn) oil, curcuma longa (turmeric) root extract, carbomer, phenyl trimethicone, propylene glycol, aminomethyl propanol, phenoxyethanol, benzoic acid, ethylhexylglycerin, glycereth-2 cocoate, parfum (fragrance), benzyl salicylate, butylphenyl methylpropional, cinnamyl alcohol, citronellol, coumarin, eugenol, geraniol, hexyl cinnamal hydroxycitronellal, limonene, linalool, caramel.  The plant root in this product plus the listed ingredients are historically known to help stimulate the scalp and nourish hair.

Warnings
To avoid skin irritation, loss of hair and/or allergic reaction, follow directions carefully. In case of adverse reaction, discontinue use and consult a medical practitioner. Do not use on irritated/inflamed skin or on recently chemically treated hair. Do not use four days before or seven days after all chemical services, not recommended for children under age 12. Avoid contact with eyes. If eye contact occurs, rinse with water. If eye irritation persists, contact a medical practitioner. Hair is flammable, flammability is increased when wearing leave-on products of this type. Keep away from sparks, flames or lit tobacco products at all times. For external use only. If ingested, consult a medical practitioner. Keep out of reach of children.
